1: * New: Guided View, with 11 guided editors covering 16 modules: Payment Gateway Fees & Discounts, PDF Invoicing, Button & Price Labels (Add to Cart, Price Labels, Sale Flash, More Button Labels), Order Numbers, Price by User Role, Wholesale Price, Checkout Custom Fields, Product Addons, Shipping Options, Left to Free Shipping, EU VAT Number, Cart Abandonment and Multicurrency.
2: * New: Live Before (live store) and After (your draft) previews on your own products, cart and checkout.
3: * New: Review & Publish. Drafts save nothing until you publish, and changes are grouped into Storefront, Orders and Outbound Emails.
4: * New: Undo, revision history and Turn Off Now in every guided editor.
5: * New: Checkout compatibility checks for the classic checkout and WooCommerce Checkout blocks, shown inside each editor.
6: * Changed: Existing stores stay in Classic View after updating. Switch views any time with one click.
7: * Security: Fixed a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) issue in frontend Product by User submissions and in date and attribute shortcodes. We recommend updating.
8: * Note: 10.1.0 replaces 10.0.0, which we withdrew after store owners told us it cluttered the admin menu and slowed things down. This release is rebuilt from 9.0.0 and adds no WooCommerce menus or admin notices.
11: * Settings backups - Export saved Booster settings and restore them after reinstalling the same edition, including general options and grouped settings.
12: * Checkout file uploads - Fix uploads with mixed-case file extensions and supported session settings. Keep staged files recoverable when an order attachment cannot be saved.
13: * Customer Return Requests - Turn on Return Requests to let signed-in customers request eligible item quantities from completed orders, follow their history and see your decision there. Verified guest access is a separate setup that needs HTTPS. Approval records your decision; it does not refund money, restock products or process a payment.
14: * Checkout Blocks - Collect supported checkout file uploads and show your Place order button text in the WooCommerce Checkout block, alongside existing supported custom fields. Existing module and edition limits still apply; this does not make every Booster option or third-party checkout compatible.
15: * Order and payment reliability - Use WooCommerce order data in affected HPOS exports and reports. Keep Booster gateway fees in sync when an eligible unpaid order changes payment method, without replacing unrelated custom fees.
16: * Understand gateway fees - See why a configured fee applies to a sample guest purchase, and check a summary of your latest up to 50 return requests. These read-only views do not change a shopper cart or predict the final checkout total. Booster Elite adds role and product facts, fee comparisons and payment/shipping rule scenarios.
17: * Hosting requirements - Requires PHP 7.3 or later on a 64-bit build with native integer hrtime() enabled. Use a maintained PHP release supported by your WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
19: * Store updates, without dashboard clutter - Receive short Booster news only on Booster settings pages. Each user can permanently dismiss a notice; store and checkout settings are unchanged.
22: * Wishlist control - Choose to keep saved products after adding them to the cart. Removal remains enabled by default, including after upgrade; disable "Remove from wishlist after adding to cart" to preserve items. Explicit removal still works.
23: * Shipping setup - Clearer guidance shows how separate category and minimum-order free-shipping methods can offer either route without duplicate free options. Existing shipping rules are not changed automatically.
24: * Security - Strengthened handling of customer-supplied product details and document processing to help keep stores protected. Updating is recommended.
25: * Branded document setup - Enter plain business details and an optional supported local logo, open a real synthetic sample, and review exact setting changes before enabling the chosen operation.
26: * Edition scope - The Light guide supports the Invoice document type, generated manually or on completed orders, with optional attachment to the customer completed-order email.
27: * Merchant control - Sample and attachment rehearsal do not send email, issue production documents or consume invoice numbers. Existing numbering, tax, advanced settings and custom templates are protected; settings undo detects later changes.
28: * Dutch continuity - Adds reviewed Dutch translations across selected core modules and the new setup guide, with English fallback outside the bounded coverage. Merchant-authored content and saved PDF templates are not translated; community and custom language overrides retain priority.
29: * Clear limits - The starter layout needs no HTML editing, but custom layouts remain in advanced settings. Sample success and attachment rehearsal do not confirm production email delivery or tax/legal compliance.
30: * Storefront continuity - Keeps setup redirects out of customer background requests after activation, so saved-list actions can work immediately.
